shots.text: Three hundred twenty ants in my colony.
shots.note: Wide: the amber tunnels, hundreds of identical trap-jaws.
Nursery: a pale new ant unfolds from its pupa among the brood.

shots.text: Not first, not last, just... in the middle.
shots.note: A single-file line of identical ants; 250 is the one in the middle.

shots.text: In the nursery tunnels, nobody learned my name because I didn't have one.
shots.note: Nurses tend the brood; 250 walks past unnoticed.
The line again, every ant carrying a crumb.

shots.text: I was good at being invisible.
shots.note: 250 in the crowd; only a tiny glint.

shots.text: Then one morning, out past the root wall,
shots.note: Dawn light through a wall of giant roots; 250 walks out.

shots.text: I stepped in something that glowed.
shots.note: The green amoeba, glowing at his feet.
